# ROCKWOOL

> ROCKWOOL provides comprehensive stone wool insulation solutions for thermal performance, fire protection, and acoustic control across residential and commercial building applications.

ROCKWOOL offers a full range of insulation products and technical resources for builders, renovators, and contractors across North America and the UK. The site includes detailed specification guides, installation instructions, case studies, and educational content on energy efficiency, fire safety, and sustainable building practices.

## Key Topics

- Stone wool insulation
- Thermal performance
- Fire protection
- Acoustic insulation
- Energy efficiency
- Building renovation
- Passive House
- BREEAM certification
- Installation guides
- Specification guides
- Noise reduction
- Sustainability
- Flat roof insulation
- ROCKWOOL Knowledge Hub
- Building Regulations

## Core Product Applications

- [Attic Insulation | ROCKWOOL](https://www.rockwool.com/north-america/applications/roof-insulation/attic-insulation): ROCKWOOL attic insulation product page for residential roof applications
- [Floor Insulation | ROCKWOOL](https://www.rockwool.com/north-america/applications/floor-insulation): ROCKWOOL stone wool floor insulation for thermal and acoustic performance
- [Acoustic Floor Insulation | ROCKWOOL](https://www.rockwool.com/north-america/applications/acoustic-insulation/acoustic-floor-insulation): ROCKWOOL acoustic floor insulation for sound dampening and noise reduction
- [Passive Fire Protection | ROCKWOOL](https://www.rockwool.com/north-america/applications/passive-fire-protection): ROCKWOOL stone wool passive fire protection solutions and applications
- [Help protect your home from fire](https://www.rockwool.com/north-america/help-protect-your-home-from-fire): ROCKWOOL fire-resistant stone wool insulation for home fire protection
